about.freeware_text: Claudius Multimedia is free for personal and commercial use. Install it on as many computers as you like and share the installer. No ads, no bundled offers, no tracking. Provided “as is”, without warranty.
about.built_with_text:
Qt 6 / PySide6 with FFmpeg - playback engine (LGPL)
Mutagen - audio tags (GPL)
LRCLIB - synced lyrics
MusicBrainz & Cover Art Archive, iTunes, Deezer - covers and tags

dup.note: Tracks with the same artist and title. The best copy (lossless, highest resolution, highest bit rate) is unticked and stays; ticked copies are removed. Play counts, ratings and favourites move to the copy that stays. Double-click a copy to listen to it.

hid.note: Items removed from the library. Their files were not touched and rescans don't add them again. Restore brings them back with their ratings, play counts and places in playlists.
hid.title: Hidden items
lib.delete_failed: These files could not be moved to the Recycle Bin (they may be in use, read-only or on a drive without a Recycle Bin). Nothing was deleted for good:
lib.delete_q:
Move {n} file(s) to the Recycle Bin?

They also leave the library and all playlists. You can get them back from the Windows Recycle Bin.
lib.forget_missing_q: Remove {n} missing file(s) from the library? Their ratings and play counts are forgotten.

lib.remove_q:
Remove {n} item(s) from the library?

The files stay on your disk and rescans won't add them again. Tools › Hidden items brings them back.
lib.restore_q:
Replace your library with the backup made on {date}?

Ratings, play counts, playlists and settings are taken from the backup. Your current library is kept as a copy in the program's data folder.
